coverage: All entries returned by each named public city endpoint when retrieved. This is not a census of all companies in those cities.
limitations: Directory classifications, office addresses, operating status and coordinates have not been independently verified for every entry.
Entries are city-location records, not a deduplicated count of unique companies.
Source approx and pin flags describe the source dataset; neither establishes independent verification.
All canonical latitude/longitude values and exact-pin publication flags are intentionally unset until reviewed.
No job availability, funding-stage or funding-amount claims were extracted.
Narrative descriptions, news, logos and source application code are not included in the deliverable.
